correctness.rationale: Rank-one Pauli purity forces a nonnegative 16-entry symplectic Walsh eigenvector. The standalone standard-library program exhaustively checks 455+1365+3003 supports by exact modular rank lower bounds, integer cofactor certificates, and strict sign tests; the only nonminimal support <=6 is one of 45 two-Lagrangian unions. The common intersection Pauli gives the Clifford normal form, and a rational signal realizes support six. No floating-point or incomplete enumeration is used.
